from solution import Artifact, clone_exhibit

root = Artifact("0")
node = root
for index in range(1, 1200):
    child = Artifact(str(index))
    node.children.append(child)
    node = child
try:
    copied = clone_exhibit(root)
except RecursionError:
    raise AssertionError("1200-node acyclic Artifact graph exceeded reference recursion depth") from None
node = copied
for index in range(1200):
    assert node.name == str(index)
    if index < 1199:
        node = node.children[0]
assert copied is not root

import unittest

from solution import Artifact, clone_exhibit


class CloneExhibitTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_constructor_creates_independent_mutable_attributes(self):
        source_tags = ["old", "rare"]
        artifact = Artifact("vase", source_tags)
        self.assertEqual(artifact.name, "vase")
        self.assertEqual(artifact.tags, source_tags)
        self.assertIsNot(artifact.tags, source_tags)
        self.assertEqual(artifact.children, [])
        self.assertIsNone(artifact.featured)
        artifact.name = "urn"
        artifact.tags.append("new")
        artifact.children.append(artifact)
        artifact.featured = artifact

    def test_none_root(self):
        self.assertIsNone(clone_exhibit(None))

    def test_clones_cycles_shared_references_and_order(self):
        root = Artifact("root", ("museum",))
        left = Artifact("left", ["blue"])
        right = Artifact("right")
        root.children = [left, right, left]
        root.featured = right
        left.children = [root]
        left.featured = right
        right.children = [right]
        right.featured = left

        clone = clone_exhibit(root)

        self.assertIsNot(clone, root)
        self.assertEqual(clone.name, "root")
        self.assertEqual(clone.tags, ["museum"])
        self.assertIsNot(clone.tags, root.tags)
        self.assertEqual([node.name for node in clone.children], ["left", "right", "left"])
        self.assertIs(clone.children[0], clone.children[2])
        self.assertIs(clone.featured, clone.children[1])
        self.assertIs(clone.children[0].children[0], clone)
        self.assertIs(clone.children[0].featured, clone.children[1])
        self.assertIs(clone.children[1].children[0], clone.children[1])
        self.assertIs(clone.children[1].featured, clone.children[0])
        self.assertIsNot(clone.children[0].tags, left.tags)

        clone.children[0].tags.append("copy-only")
        self.assertEqual(left.tags, ["blue"])
        self.assertEqual(root.children, [left, right, left])

    def test_rejects_invalid_reachable_nodes_and_fields(self):
        cases = []
        bad_name = Artifact("ok")
        bad_name.name = 7
        cases.append(bad_name)
        bad_tags = Artifact("ok")
        bad_tags.tags = ["valid", 3]
        cases.append(bad_tags)
        bad_children_container = Artifact("ok")
        bad_children_container.children = ()
        cases.append(bad_children_container)
        bad_child = Artifact("ok")
        bad_child.children = [object()]
        cases.append(bad_child)
        bad_featured = Artifact("ok")
        bad_featured.featured = "not an artifact"
        cases.append(bad_featured)

        for root in cases:
            with self.subTest(root=root):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    clone_exhibit(root)

    def test_validation_does_not_mutate_graph(self):
        root = Artifact("root", ["tag"])
        child = Artifact("child")
        root.children = [child]
        child.featured = 42
        original_children = list(root.children)
        original_tags = list(root.tags)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            clone_exhibit(root)
        self.assertEqual(root.children, original_children)
        self.assertEqual(root.tags, original_tags)
        self.assertEqual(child.featured, 42)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
